about: Catalogue expansion for the beta. Facts (year, length, credits) were compiled from general knowledge; where an open source matches a work, its values replace these and the change is recorded (fact_sources). Terms, advisories and summaries are AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. Ratings are unverified.

works.title: Pride and Prejudice
works.summary: Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr Darcy misjudge each other across a season of balls, proposals and family embarrassments.

works.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
works.summary: In Depression-era Alabama, a girl watches her lawyer father defend a Black man falsely accused of rape.

sexual-content: An alleged rape is discussed at trial.

works.title: The Great Gatsby
